title: Meeting room display
passage: A. A chart is being removed from a wall. B. The chairs have been piled in a corner. C. A line graph is displayed behind the people. D. Everyone is standing around a table.
passageZh:
A. 一張圖表正從牆上被取下。
B. 椅子被堆在角落。
C. 人們後方展示著折線圖。
D. 所有人都站在桌子周圍。
